evidence: One pre-reset refresh token succeeded twice after the password changed; real JWT verification and bcrypt, mocked user/OTP persistence.
Two concurrent calls using one reset OTP both succeeded and each wrote a different password; no database used.
Public forgot-password token discloses ADMIN for an existing fixture account and INSTRUCTOR for an absent fixture account.
Six distinct emails sharing the BFF source IP: five accepted by guard, sixth rejected for 900 seconds; counter mocked.
Two separate withdrawal intents at a recurring balance produced the same Stripe idempotency key.
Fifty bounded events with different UUIDs created fifty retained map entries and fifty service lookups; no sockets/network used.
A valid two-factor challenge is returned as terminal login failure; only email/password credentials are accepted by the admin provider.
A sibling-origin text/plain request reached the mocked payout API and returned 201; real-browser cookie delivery remains untested.
Two web-valid passwords with the same first 72 bytes and different suffixes compare equal under installed bcrypt.
Two concurrent duplicate checks both created a waitlist row; persistence mocked. Schema has no email/type unique constraint.
Admin BFF strips a supplied role; actual backend DTO validation rejects the forwarded body for missing role. No account created.
